div.head: II Cn 38.2
div.ab: ⁊ godcunde bote sece mann symle georne be boctæcinge, ⁊ woruldcunde bote sece man be woruldlage.
And godcunde bote sec mann symle georne be boctale, ⁊ for woruldcunde bote sece mann be weorldlage.
Et Deo gratam emendationem sedulo perquiramus de scripturis sanctis et secularem iuxta legem seculi.
⁊ godcunde bote sece man georne ⁊ symble be boctale, ⁊ woruldbote sece man be woruldlage.
And godcunde bote sece mann symle georne be boctæcinge, and woruldcunde bote sece man be woruldlage.
And ecclesiastical amends shall always be diligently exacted in accordance with the directions contained in the canon law, and secular amends in accordance with secular law.
And spiritual penance shall always be assessed according to canon law, and secular penalties according to the civil law.
And ecclesiastical amends are always to be diligently demanded according to the instruction in books [of penance] and secular amends according to the secular law.
Und geistliche Busse erstrebe man immer (und B) eifrig gemäss [kanonischer] Bücher-Anweisung (-Aussage B A), und (um A) weltliche Busse erstrebe man gemäss staatlichem Rechte.
And let spiritual atonement always be sought eagerly according to the teaching (the word, B A) of the [canonical] books, and let secular compensation be sought according to secular law.
div.note: symle georne: georne and symble B
and woruldcunde: and for woruldcunde A; and woruldbote B
